place: Bang Por, Maenam, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Hilltop Five-Bedroom Seaview Villa with Infinity Pool in Bang Por
blurb: A newly built five-bedroom villa by architect Gary Fell of GFAB, set roughly 180 m above the sea in the quiet hills of Bang Por, on Koh Samui's north coast. Four levels of open-plan living step down to a 15 m infinity pool and sunken sala, framing an unbroken sweep across the Gulf toward Koh Phangan and the Ang Thong marine park. Cinema, sea-view gym, massage room and staff quarters, on a full Chanote title. ฿84,000,000.
detail:
Completed in 2023, this contemporary villa occupies a private ridge roughly 180 metres above sea level in the hills behind Bang Por, a quiet stretch of Koh Samui's north coast about 25 minutes from the airport and 800 metres from the beach. The elevation buys one of the island's widest sunset sea views — an uninterrupted sweep across the Gulf of Thailand toward Koh Phangan and the Ang Thong archipelago.

Designed by the acclaimed architect Gary Fell of GFAB Architects, the house is arranged over four levels that step down the slope, so almost every room opens to the water. Open-plan living and dining spaces flow through full-height glazing onto wide terraces, with two fully fitted kitchens for easy entertaining. Five en-suite bedrooms sleep up to twelve, finished with stone, timber and floor-to-ceiling glass.

Outside, a 15-metre infinity pool runs to the horizon, with a sunken poolside sala and BBQ for long lunches and sundowners. Leisure and wellness spaces include a home cinema, a sea-view gym and yoga room, and a dedicated massage room, while a self-contained staff apartment sits alongside covered parking for four cars. Smart-home controls manage lighting, climate and security throughout.

The 1,600 m² plot (one rai) holds 1,096 m² of interior space plus 206 m² of covered terraces, reached by a private road. The villa sits on a full Chanote title and can be acquired freehold through a Thai company structure or on a registered leasehold, with a private high-voltage electricity supply on a government meter and a deep-well water source. Floor plans, ownership options and inventory on request.

A near-identical twin villa directly next door is available separately — completed in 2012 and priced at ฿74,000,000 — so the two can be taken together as a family or investment compound. Contact us for details on the neighbouring villa.
